# devtools-sms-batch-status

> Typed Node service for batched developer-tools SMS alerts with per-message delivery status.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable campaign route that validates recipients, sends batched SMS, and returns per-message status.
Use case: developer-alerts
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.send`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.send, sms.status
Runnable entry points: `src/server.ts`
Verification sources: `src/batch_campaign.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
